newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Freightways sets spin-off dates.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Freightways sets spin-off dates.

text.p: Consolidated Freightways Inc said on Thursday it set Nov. 15 as the record date and Dec. 2 as the distribution date in the spin-off that will separate it into two publicly traded companies.

As previously announced, Consolidated Freightways will spin off Consolidated Freightways Corp of Delaware into a new company called Consolidated Freightways Corp (CFC) with revenues of approximately $2.1 billion.
Consolidated Freightways Inc, the current parent company, will will change its name to CNF Transportation Inc and have annual revenues of about $3.6 billion.
The company has received the necessary tax ruling from the Internal Revenue Service for a tax-free distribution of shares.
All Consolidated Freightways Inc. shareholders of record will receive one share of CFC stock for every two shares of company stock owned on November 15, 1996.
Starting about November 13, CFC is expected to begin trading on a "when issued" basis on the Nasdaq National Market Stock Exchange under the symbol CFWY.
